documents.title: Allergy & Immunology Progress Note
documents.content:
## Sophia – Patient Progress

**Date:** October 26, 2023

**HPI:**  Patient reports persistent, severe atopic dermatitis with markedly elevated IgE levels (1600 IU/mL). Significant pruritus is present, exacerbated by scratching. Reports feeling increasingly fatigued and frustrated due to the condition’s ongoing nature. Current treatment regimen includes dupilumab biologic therapy.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient presents with diffuse erythema and scaling on the trunk and extremities. Skin appears dry and inflamed. No evidence of secondary infection. Vital signs within normal limits.

**Management Plan:**  Continue dupilumab titration as prescribed, monitoring IgE levels weekly. Implement topical moisturizers and antihistamines to manage pruritus. Encourage patient adherence to prescribed regimen and

diagnostics.conclusion: Total Serum Immunoglobulin E (IgE) abnormal findings: Severe Refractory Atopic Dermatitis with extreme IgE elevation. Key indicators: total IgE > 1600 IU/mL, severe pruritus.
